lines.text: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - NIGHT
Jake Whitmore, 29, physically corners 24-year-old nurse Harper Lane outside the ambulance bay doors.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I will never sign those papers, Jake.

lines.speaker: JAKE WHITMORE
lines.text: Then watch your seventeen-year-old sister Mia lose her hospital funding and die tonight!

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - ER TRAUMA ROOM - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - ER TRAUMA ROOM - NIGHT
Cole Whitmore, 32, stumbles off a stretcher despite his critical chest stab wound from the recent alley ambush.

lines.speaker: COLE HAYES
lines.text: I have to stop Diane from stealing my company.

scenes.heading: INT. WHITMORE SHIPPING - EXECUTIVE SUITE - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. WHITMORE SHIPPING - EXECUTIVE SUITE - NIGHT
Diane Whitmore, 58, calmly stamps the corporate transfer documents to finalize seizing control after poisoning Evelyn.

lines.speaker: DIANE WHITMORE
lines.text: With Evelyn dead and Cole bleeding out, the empire is finally ours, son.

scenes.heading: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - PARKING LOT - NIGHT

lines.text: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - PARKING LOT - NIGHT
Harper stands frozen with a pen in her trembling hand while Jake holds her medical clearance papers hostage.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Stop! I'll sign it. Just don't hurt Mia.

scenes.heading: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - AMBULANCE BAY - NIGHT

lines.text: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - AMBULANCE BAY - NIGHT
Cole staggers out into the cold night air and grabs Jake's shoulder from behind with a bloody hand.

lines.speaker: COLE HAYES
lines.text: Step away from my wife, Jake.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - LOBBY - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - LOBBY - NIGHT
A masked security guard hired by Diane suddenly tasers Cole in the back, dropping the CEO to the floor.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: No! Cole!

lines.speaker: JAKE WHITMORE
lines.text: Too late, brother. Sign the line, Harper.
